notes: Percentages on a look now set the amount. “Make it 20% brighter” is brighter than “make it 10% brighter”, where before both got the same small lift, and “30% more contrast” or “20% less saturated” do exactly that. “Make it twice as big” upscales 2×, where before Crisp said it didn’t understand. And “compress it as much as possible” or “make the file as small as you can” now make the smallest file, instead of the middle setting.
